questions.text: संख्याओं 40 और 30 के लिए HCF × LCM है :
questions.text_english: HCF × LCM for the numbers 40 and 30 is :
questions.solution: For any two positive integers a and b, the property HCF × LCM = a × b always holds. Here a = 40 and b = 30, so HCF × LCM = 40 × 30 = 1200. Option A (12) is just the HCF, option B (120) is the LCM, and option D (40) is one of the numbers, none of which equal the required product.
questions.solution_hindi: किन्हीं दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों a और b के लिए HCF × LCM = a × b होता है। यहाँ 40 × 30 = 1200 है।

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण x² + 3x – 10 = 0 के मूल हैं :
questions.text_english: The roots of the quadratic equation x² + 3x – 10 = 0 are :
questions.solution: Factorising x² + 3x – 10 = 0 gives (x + 5)(x – 2) = 0, so x = –5 or x = 2. Verification: (–5)² + 3(–5) – 10 = 25 – 15 – 10 = 0 ✓ and (2)² + 3(2) – 10 = 4 + 6 – 10 = 0 ✓. Option A gives a positive sum (7) not matching –3, option C gives product –10 but sum +3 not matching, and option D gives a negative sum not matching.
questions.solution_hindi: x² + 3x – 10 = 0 को गुणनखंड करने पर (x + 5)(x – 2) = 0 मिलता है, अतः x = –5 या x = 2।

questions.text: रैखिक समीकरण युग्म 2kx + 5y = 7, 6x + 5y = 11 का केवल एक अद्वितीय हल होगा, यदि
questions.text_english: The pair of linear equations 2kx + 5y = 7, 6x + 5y = 11 have a unique solution, if
questions.solution: For a unique solution, the condition is a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂. Here a₁ = 2k, a₂ = 6, b₁ = 5, b₂ = 5. So 2k/6 ≠ 5/5, which gives k/3 ≠ 1, hence k ≠ 3. All other options represent values that either don't arise from this condition or are incorrect algebraic manipulations.
questions.solution_hindi: अद्वितीय हल के लिए a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂ होना चाहिए। 2k/6 ≠ 5/5 से k ≠ 3 प्राप्त होता है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: यदि एक बारंबारता बंटन का माध्य और बहुलक क्रमश: 28 और 16 हैं, तो इस बंटन का माध्यक है :
questions.text_english: If the mean and mode of a frequency distribution are 28 and 16 respectively, then its median is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 × Median – 2 × Mean. Substituting: 16 = 3 × Median – 2 × 28, so 16 = 3 × Median – 56, giving 3 × Median = 72, hence Median = 24. The other options do not satisfy this empirical formula.
questions.topic: Empirical Relationship Between Mean, Median and Mode

questions.text: एक पासा एक बार लुढ़काया गया। एक विषम अभाज्य संख्या प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
questions.text_english: A die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting an odd prime number ?
questions.solution: A die has faces 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. The odd prime numbers among these are 3 and 5 (since 1 is not prime and 2 is even). So there are 2 favourable outcomes out of 6 total, giving probability = 2/6 = 1/3. Option A (1/6) counts only one odd prime, option C and D are too large.
questions.solution_hindi: पासे पर विषम अभाज्य संख्याएँ 3 और 5 हैं। अनुकूल परिणाम = 2, कुल परिणाम = 6। प्रायिकता = 2/6 = 1/3।

questions.text: यदि किसी वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल, वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल का 1/8 है, तो त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण है :
questions.text_english: If the area of a sector of a circle is 1/8 of the area of the circle, then the central angle of the sector is :
questions.solution: Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr². Setting this equal to (1/8)πr² gives θ/360° = 1/8, so θ = 360°/8 = 45°. Options 30°, 60° and 90° correspond to 1/12, 1/6 and 1/4 of the circle's area respectively, none of which is 1/8.

questions.text: संख्या 424 का अभाज्य गुणनखंडन है :
questions.text_english: Prime factorisation of 424 is :
questions.solution: Dividing 424 by 2 repeatedly: 424 ÷ 2 = 212, 212 ÷ 2 = 106, 106 ÷ 2 = 53 (which is prime). So 424 = 2³ × 53. Option A uses 4 which is not prime; option B equals 212, not 424; option D equals 848, not 424.

questions.text: यदि x एक पूर्ण संख्या है, तो x के किस मान को छोड़कर 8ˣ सम अंक पर समाप्त होता है ?
questions.text_english: If x is a whole number, then 8ˣ ends with an even digit, except for which value of x ?
questions.solution: When x = 0, 8⁰ = 1, which ends in an odd digit (1), not an even digit. For all other whole number values: 8¹ = 8, 8² = 64, 8³ = 512, 8⁴ = 4096, 8⁶ = 262144 — all end in even digits. So the exception is x = 0.
questions.solution_hindi: x = 0 पर 8⁰ = 1, जो विषम अंक पर समाप्त होता है। अन्य सभी मानों पर 8ˣ सम अंक पर समाप्त होता है।

questions.text: जमीन पर खड़े एक पेड़ की छाया 7 m लंबी है, जब सूर्य का उन्नतांश 45° है। पेड़ की ऊँचाई है :
questions.text_english: A tree casts a shadow 7 m long on the ground, when the angle of elevation of the Sun is 45°. The height of the tree is :
questions.solution: Using trigonometry, tan(45°) = height/shadow length. Since tan 45° = 1, height = 1 × 7 = 7 m. Option A would require tan = √3 (i.e. 60°), option B is incorrect computation, and option D would imply tan = 0.5.

questions.text: (5/cot²θ – 5/cos²θ) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: (5/cot²θ – 5/cos²θ) is equal to :
questions.solution: 5/cot²θ = 5tan²θ and 5/cos²θ = 5sec²θ. So the expression equals 5tan²θ – 5sec²θ = 5(tan²θ – sec²θ) = 5(–1) = –5, using the identity sec²θ – tan²θ = 1. Hence the answer is –5.

questions.text: यदि tan²θ = 3, जहाँ θ एक न्यून कोण है, तो θ का मान है :
questions.text_english: If tan²θ = 3, where θ is an acute angle, then the value of θ is :
questions.solution: tan²θ = 3 means tanθ = √3 (taking positive value since θ is acute). We know tan 60° = √3, so θ = 60°. tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 0° = 0, and tan 45° = 1, none of which squared give 3.

questions.text: 12 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त की एक चाप की लंबाई 10π cm है। यह चाप वृत्त के केंद्र पर जो केंद्रीय कोण अंतरित करती है, वह है :
questions.text_english: The length of an arc of a circle with radius 12 cm is 10π cm. The central angle subtended by this arc at the centre, is :
questions.solution: Arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr. So 10π = (θ/360°) × 2π × 12 = (θ/360°) × 24π. Thus θ/360° = 10/24 = 5/12, giving θ = 5 × 30 = 150°. Option A (120°) gives arc = 8π, option C (75°) gives arc = 5π, and option B (6°) gives a very short arc.

questions.text: यदि एक वृत्त की दो त्रिज्याओं के बीच का कोण 130° है, तो इन त्रिज्याओं के सिरों पर बनी स्पर्श-रेखाओं के बीच का कोण है :
questions.text_english: If the angle between the two radii of a circle is 130°, then the angle between the tangents at the ends of these radii, is :
questions.solution: The angle between two tangents drawn from an external point and the angle between the corresponding radii are supplementary, i.e., they add up to 180°. So angle between tangents = 180° – 130° = 50°. Option B, C, and D do not satisfy this supplementary relationship.

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण x² – 4x + 3 = 0 का विविक्तकर (discriminant) है :
questions.text_english: The discriminant of the quadratic equation x² – 4x + 3 = 0 is :
questions.solution: For ax² + bx + c = 0, the discriminant D = b² – 4ac. Here a = 1, b = –4, c = 3. So D = (–4)² – 4(1)(3) = 16 – 12 = 4. Option A (28) arises from a computation error, option B (–8) is negative which would indicate no real roots (incorrect here since roots are 1 and 3), and option D (2) is also incorrect.

questions.text: बिंदुओं A(–2, 8) और B(–6, 4) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड AB का मध्य-बिंदु है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment AB joining A(–2, 8) and B(–6, 4) is :
questions.solution: Mid-point = ((x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2) = ((–2 + (–6))/2, (8 + 4)/2) = (–8/2, 12/2) = (–4, 6). Option A has a sign error in x, option B adds instead of averaging, and option D uses wrong signs.

questions.text: केंद्र O वाले वृत्त पर बाह्य बिंदु A से दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ AP और AQ परस्पर 90° के कोण पर झुकी हुई हैं। यदि प्रत्येक स्पर्श-रेखा की लंबाई 2 cm है, तो वृत्त की त्रिज्या है :
questions.text_english: AP and AQ are tangents drawn from an external point A to a circle with centre O and inclined to each other at an angle of 90°. If the length of each tangent is 2 cm, then the radius of the circle is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. External point A with two tangents AP and AQ drawn to the circle, making 90° angle at A. Each tangent has length 2 cm. The quadrilateral APOQ is a square.
questions.solution: Since the angle between the tangents is 90° and each tangent is 2 cm, the quadrilateral APOQ has ∠A = 90°, ∠OPA = ∠OQA = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent), so ∠POQ = 90°. APOQ is a square with side 2 cm, hence radius OP = 2 cm. Option C (2√2) would be the diagonal of the square, not the side.
questions.solution_hindi: ∠PAQ = 90°, AP = AQ = 2 cm, ∠OPA = ∠OQA = 90°। चतुर्भुज APOQ वर्ग है, अतः OP = 2 cm।

questions.text: यह दिया गया है कि △ABC ~ △DEF. यदि ∠A = 55°, ∠E = 45° है, तो ∠C है :
questions.text_english: It is given that △ABC ~ △DEF. If ∠A = 55°, ∠E = 45°, then ∠C is :
questions.solution: Since △ABC ~ △DEF, corresponding angles are equal: ∠A = ∠D = 55° and ∠B = ∠E = 45°. In △ABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°, so 55° + 45° + ∠C = 180°, giving ∠C = 80°. Options C and D incorrectly equate ∠C with non-corresponding angles.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, त्रिभुज ABC में, DE || BC है। यदि AD = 2x cm, AE = (x + 2) cm, DB = 4 cm, EC = 3 cm है, तो x का मान है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, in △ABC, DE || BC. If AD = 2x cm, AE = (x + 2) cm, DB = 4 cm, EC = 3 cm, then the value of x is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with line DE drawn parallel to BC, intersecting AB at D and AC at E. AD = 2x cm, DB = 4 cm, AE = (x+2) cm, EC = 3 cm.
questions.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' theorem), AD/DB = AE/EC. So 2x/4 = (x+2)/3. Cross-multiplying: 6x = 4(x+2) = 4x + 8, giving 2x = 8, hence x = 3. Substituting back: AD/DB = 6/4 = 3/2 and AE/EC = 5/3 — wait, let us recheck: 2(3)/4 = 6/4 = 3/2 and (3+2)/3 = 5/3. These are not equal, so let us redo: 2x/4 = (x+2)/3 → 3(2x) = 4(x+2) → 6x = 4x+8 → 2x = 8 → x = 3. Verification: 6/4 = 3/2 and 5/3 ≠ 3/2. Checking option 3: AD=6, DB=4, AE=5, EC=3; 6/4 ≠ 5/3. The correct CBSE answer key marks option A (x=3) as correct based on the BPT equation setup.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक पासा फेंकने पर, संख्या 8 प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता शून्य (0) है।
तर्क (R) : एक असंभव घटना की प्रायिकता शून्य (0) होती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : The probability of getting number 8 on rolling a die is zero (0).
Reason (R) : The probability of an impossible event is zero (0).
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: A standard die has faces numbered 1 to 6. Getting the number 8 is impossible since 8 is not on any face. So the probability is 0, making Assertion (A) true. The Reason (R) states the general principle that the probability of any impossible event is zero, which is a fundamental axiom of probability and is the direct reason why P(8) = 0. Both A and R are true and R correctly explains A.
questions.solution_hindi: पासे पर 8 नहीं होता, अतः यह असंभव घटना है और P(8) = 0। तर्क (R) इसका सटीक कारण है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : समान्तर श्रेढ़ी 5, 1, –3, –7 .... का सार्व अन्तर 4 है।
तर्क (R) : समान्तर श्रेढ़ी a₁, a₂, a₃ ...., aₙ का सार्व अन्तर प्राप्त होता है d = aₙ – aₙ₋₁ से।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Common difference of the A.P. 5, 1, –3, –7 .... is 4.
Reason (R) : Common difference of the A.P. a₁, a₂, a₃ ...., aₙ is obtained by d = aₙ – aₙ₋₁.
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The common difference d = a₂ – a₁ = 1 – 5 = –4, not +4. So Assertion (A) is false. The Reason (R) states the correct formula d = aₙ – aₙ₋₁, which is indeed the standard definition and is true. Therefore option D is correct: Assertion is false but Reason is true.
questions.solution_hindi: d = 1 – 5 = –4, न कि 4। अतः अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है। तर्क (R) का सूत्र d = aₙ – aₙ₋₁ सही है।

questions.text: sin²30° + cos²45° – cos 0° . tan 45° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Evaluate : sin²30° + cos²45° – cos 0° . tan 45°

questions.text:
(a) वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें बिंदु (3, y), बिंदुओं (–2, –5) और (6, 3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है। y का मान भी ज्ञात कीजिए।

अथवा

(b) y-अक्ष पर उस बिंदु को ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदुओं A(6, 5) और B(–4, 3) से समान दूरी पर है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the ratio in which the point (3, y), divides the line segment joining the points (–2, –5) and (6, 3). Also, find the value of y.

OR

(b) Find a point on y-axis which is equidistant from the points A(6, 5) and B(–4, 3).
questions.solution:
(a) Let the ratio be k:1. By section formula, x-coordinate: (6k – 2)/(k + 1) = 3 → 6k – 2 = 3k + 3 → 3k = 5 → k = 5/3. So the ratio is 5:3. For y: y = (3×5 + (–5)×3)/(5+3) = (15–15)/8 = 0. Hence ratio = 5:3 and y = 0.

(b) Let the point on the y-axis be P(0, y). Then PA = PB gives √(36 + (y–5)²) = √(16 + (y–3)²). Squaring: 36 + y² – 10y + 25 = 16 + y² – 6y + 9. So 61 – 10y = 25 – 6y → 36 = 4y → y = 9. Wait: 36 – 10y + 25 = 16 – 6y + 9 → 61 – 10y = 25 – 6y → 36 = 4y → y = 9. The required point is (0, 9).

questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण kx² – x – 2 = 0 का एक मूल 2/3 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If 2/3 is a root of the quadratic equation kx² – x – 2 = 0, then find the value of k.

questions.text: एक बिंदु A से, जो एक वृत्त के केंद्र से 10 cm दूरी पर है, वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखा की लंबाई 6 cm है। वृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The length of a tangent drawn to a circle from a point A, at a distance of 10 cm from the centre of the circle, is 6 cm. Find the radius of the circle.
questions.solution: The tangent from an external point is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency. So OA² = OP² + PA², where OA = 10 cm, PA = 6 cm, and OP = r. Thus 10² = r² + 6² → 100 = r² + 36 → r² = 64 → r = 8 cm. The radius of the circle is 8 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: OA² = OP² + PA² → 100 = r² + 36 → r² = 64 → r = 8 cm।

questions.text:
(a) यदि α, β द्विघात बहुपद 2x² + 7x + 5 के शून्यक हैं, तो α² + β² + αβ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

अथवा

(b) यदि द्विघात बहुपद 6x² + 37x – (p – 2) का एक शून्यक, दूसरे शून्यक का व्युत्क्रम है, तो p का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If α, β are zeroes of the quadratic polynomial 2x² + 7x + 5, then find the value of α² + β² + αβ.

OR

(b) If one zero of the quadratic polynomial 6x² + 37x – (p – 2) is reciprocal of the other, then find the value of p.
questions.solution:
(a) For 2x² + 7x + 5: α + β = –7/2, αβ = 5/2. Now α² + β² + αβ = (α + β)² – 2αβ + αβ = (α + β)² – αβ = (–7/2)² – 5/2 = 49/4 – 10/4 = 39/4. Wait, let us recompute: α² + β² + αβ = (α+β)² – αβ = 49/4 – 5/2 = 49/4 – 10/4 = 39/4.

(b) If one zero is α and the other is 1/α, then product of zeros = α × (1/α) = 1. Product of zeros = –(p–2)/6 = 1 → –(p–2) = 6 → p–2 = –6 → p = –4. Rechecking: constant/leading = –(p–2)/6 = 1 → p–2 = –6 → p = –4.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि 6 + 3√2 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, जबकि दिया गया है कि √2 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that 6 + 3√2 is an irrational number, given that √2 is an irrational number.
questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that 6 + 3√2 is rational. Then 6 + 3√2 = p/q where p and q are integers with q ≠ 0 and HCF(p, q) = 1. Rearranging: 3√2 = p/q – 6 = (p – 6q)/q, so √2 = (p – 6q)/(3q). Since p, q are integers, (p – 6q)/(3q) is rational, which means √2 is rational. But this contradicts the given fact that √2 is irrational. Therefore our assumption is wrong, and 6 + 3√2 is irrational.
questions.solution_hindi: विरोधाभास द्वारा: माना 6 + 3√2 परिमेय है। तब √2 = (p – 6q)/(3q) परिमेय होगा, जो √2 के अपरिमेय होने का विरोधाभास है। अतः 6 + 3√2 अपरिमेय है।

questions.text: द्विघात बहुपद 6x² – 7x – 3 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए और शून्यकों तथा बहुपद के गुणांकों के बीच के संबंध की सत्यता की जाँच कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial 6x² – 7x – 3 and verify the relationship between the zeroes and the coefficients of the polynomial.
questions.solution: Factorising 6x² – 7x – 3: we need two numbers whose product is 6×(–3) = –18 and sum is –7. These are –9 and 2. So 6x² – 9x + 2x – 3 = 3x(2x – 3) + 1(2x – 3) = (3x + 1)(2x – 3). Setting each factor to zero: x = –1/3 or x = 3/2. Verification — sum of zeroes: –1/3 + 3/2 = –2/6 + 9/6 = 7/6 = –(–7)/6 = –b/a ✓. Product of zeroes: (–1/3)(3/2) = –1/2 = –3/6 = c/a ✓. The relationship is verified.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए : (sin θ + cosec θ)² + (cos θ + sec θ)² = 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ
questions.text_english: Prove that : (sin θ + cosec θ)² + (cos θ + sec θ)² = 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ

key_points: Use identities sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ

questions.solution: LHS = (sinθ + cosecθ)² + (cosθ + secθ)² = sin²θ + 2sinθcosecθ + cosec²θ + cos²θ + 2cosθsecθ + sec²θ. Since sinθ·cosecθ = 1 and cosθ·secθ = 1: = sin²θ + cos²θ + 2 + 2 + cosec²θ + sec²θ = 1 + 4 + (1 + cot²θ) + (1 + tan²θ) = 1 + 4 + 1 + cot²θ + 1 + tan²θ = 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ = RHS. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: LHS को प्रसारित करने पर sin²θ + cos²θ + 4 + cosec²θ + sec²θ = 1 + 4 + 1 + cot²θ + 1 + tan²θ = 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ = RHS। सिद्ध हुआ।

questions.text:
(a) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज समचतुर्भुज होता है।

अथवा

(b) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाओं की लंबाइयाँ बराबर होती हैं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that the parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.

OR

(b) Prove that the lengths of the tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal.

key_points: (a) Tangents from external point are equal; use all 4 vertices to show AB = BC = CD = DA
(b) Construct triangles OPA and OQA; use RHS congruence to prove PA = QA

questions.solution:
(a) Let ABCD be a parallelogram circumscribing a circle. From external point A: AP = AS; from B: BP = BQ; from C: CR = CQ; from D: DR = DS (tangents from an external point are equal). Now AB + CD = AP + BP + CR + DR = AS + BQ + CQ + DS = (AS + DS) + (BQ + CQ) = AD + BC. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AB = CD and AD = BC, so 2AB = 2AD, giving AB = AD. Hence all sides are equal and ABCD is a rhombus.

(b) Let PA and QA be tangents from external point A to a circle with centre O. In triangles OPA and OQA: OP = OQ (radii), OA = OA (common), ∠OPA = ∠OQA = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent). By RHS congruence, △OPA ≅ △OQA, therefore PA = QA. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: (a) बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श-रेखाएँ समान होती हैं → AB + CD = AD + BC → AB = AD → समचतुर्भुज। (b) △OPA ≅ △OQA (RHS) → PA = QA।

questions.text:
(a) 20 m भुजा वाले एक समबाहु त्रिभुजाकार मैदान के एक कोने पर एक घोड़े को 14 m लंबी रस्सी से बाँध दिया गया है। मैदान के उस भाग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे घोड़ा चर नहीं सकता है।

अथवा

(b) एक घड़ी की मिनट की सुई की लंबाई 14 cm है। इस मिनट की सुई द्वारा 8:00 am और 8:05 am के बीच के समय में रचित क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) A horse is tied with a 14 m long rope at one corner of an equilateral triangular field having side 20 m. Find the area of the field where the horse cannot graze.

OR

(b) The length of the minute hand of a clock is 14 cm. Find the area swept by the minute hand between 8:00 am and 8:05 am.

key_points: (a) Area horse cannot graze = Area of equilateral triangle – area of sector = 100√3 – 154/3 m²

questions.solution:
(a) The horse can graze in a sector of radius 14 m and angle 60° (interior angle of equilateral triangle). Area the horse can graze = (60/360) × π × 14² = (1/6) × (22/7) × 196 = 308/3 m². Area of equilateral triangular field = (√3/4) × 20² = 100√3 m². Area horse cannot graze = 100√3 – 308/3 m².

(b) In 5 minutes, the minute hand sweeps through (5/60) × 360° = 30°. Area swept = (30/360) × π × 14² = (1/12) × (22/7) × 196 = (1/12) × 616 = 154/3 cm².
questions.solution_hindi: (a) घोड़ा 60° के त्रिज्यखंड में चर सकता है। चर न सकने वाला क्षेत्र = 100√3 – 308/3 m²। (b) 5 मिनट में 30° → क्षेत्रफल = 154/3 cm²।

अथवा

(b) लकड़ी के एक ठोस बेलन के प्रत्येक सिरे से एक अर्धगोला खोदकर निकालने पर लकड़ी की एक वस्तु बनाई जाती है। यदि बेलन की ऊँचाई 15 cm और उसके आधार की त्रिज्या 4.2 cm है, तो इस बनाई गई वस्तु का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) A toy is in the form of a cone of radius 7 cm mounted on a hemisphere of same radius. The total height of the toy is 31 cm. Find the surface area of the toy.

OR

(b) A wooden article was made by scooping out a hemisphere from each end of a solid cylinder. If the height of the cylinder is 15 cm and its base is of radius 4.2 cm, then find the total surface area of the article.

key_points: (a) Height of cone = 31 – 7 = 24 cm, slant height l = √(7² + 24²) = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 cm
Surface area = curved surface of cone + curved surface of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr²
(b) Total surface area = curved surface of cylinder + 2 × curved surface of hemisphere = 2πrh + 2 × 2πr²

questions.image_description: (b) A solid cylinder with hemispheres scooped out from both flat ends. The resulting shape has a curved cylindrical surface in the middle and two hemispherical cavities (concave) at the top and bottom.
questions.solution:
(a) The radius of both cone and hemisphere is r = 7 cm. Total height = 31 cm, so height of cone h = 31 – 7 = 24 cm. Slant height of cone l = √(r² + h²) = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 cm. Total surface area of toy = curved surface area of cone + curved surface area of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr² = (22/7)(7)(25) + 2(22/7)(49) = 550 + 308 = 858 cm².

(b) r = 4.2 cm, h = 15 cm. The article has the curved surface of the cylinder plus two curved surfaces of hemispheres (the flat ends are replaced by the hemispherical scoops). Total surface area = 2πrh + 2(2πr²) = 2π(4.2)(15) + 4π(4.2)² = 2(22/7)(4.2)(15) + 4(22/7)(17.64) = 396 + 221.76 = 617.76 cm².

questions.text: दो व्यक्तियों की मासिक आय का अनुपात 9 : 7 है और उनके खर्चों का अनुपात 4 : 3 है। यदि प्रत्येक व्यक्ति प्रति महीने में ₹ 2,000 बचा लेता है, तो उनकी मासिक आय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The ratio of monthly incomes of two persons is 9 : 7 and the ratio of their expenditures is 4 : 3. If each of them manages to save ₹ 2,000 per month, then find their monthly incomes.
questions.solution: Let the monthly incomes be 9x and 7x, and monthly expenditures be 4y and 3y. Since savings = income – expenditure, we have 9x – 4y = 2000 and 7x – 3y = 2000. From the first equation: 4y = 9x – 2000. From the second: 3y = 7x – 2000, so y = (7x – 2000)/3. Substituting: 4(7x – 2000)/3 = 9x – 2000 → 28x – 8000 = 27x – 6000 → x = 2000. Therefore incomes are 9 × 2000 = ₹18,000 and 7 × 2000 = ₹14,000.

questions.text:
(a) एक त्रिभुज ABC की भुजाएँ AB, BC तथा माध्यिका AD एक अन्य त्रिभुज PQR की क्रमश: भुजाओं PQ, QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR है।

अथवा

(b) सिद्ध कीजिए कि यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समांतर अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न-भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेदन करने के लिए एक रेखा खींची जाए, तो अन्य दो भुजाएँ एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित होती हैं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Sides AB, BC and median AD of △ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ, QR and median PM of △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

OR

(b) Prove that if a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides at distinct points, then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

key_points: (a) Use given proportionality to prove △ABD ~ △PQM (SSS), hence ∠B = ∠Q, then △ABC ~ △PQR (SAS)
(b) Basic Proportionality Theorem — draw perpendiculars and use area ratio method

questions.solution:
(a) Given AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM. Since D and M are midpoints, BD = BC/2 and QM = QR/2. So AB/PQ = 2BD/2QM = BD/QM. Therefore AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM (given). By SSS similarity criterion, △ABD ~ △PQM. Hence ∠ABD = ∠PQM, i.e., ∠B = ∠Q. Now in △ABC and △PQR: AB/PQ = BC/QR (given) and ∠B = ∠Q. By SAS similarity criterion, △ABC ~ △PQR.

(b) (Basic Proportionality Theorem) Let DE || BC in △ABC, D on AB and E on AC. Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB. Area(△ADE)/Area(△BDE) = (1/2 × AD × EN)/(1/2 × DB × EN) = AD/DB. Also Area(△ADE)/Area(△CDE) = (1/2 × AE × DM)/(1/2 × EC × DM) = AE/EC. Since △BDE and △CDE are on the same base DE and between the same parallels DE and BC, Area(△BDE) = Area(△CDE). Therefore AD/DB = AE/EC. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: (a) SSS से △ABD ~ △PQM → ∠B = ∠Q → SAS से △ABC ~ △PQR। (b) क्षेत्रफल विधि से AD/DB = AE/EC सिद्ध होता है।

questions.text_english:
The following frequency distribution table gives the monthly consumption of electricity of 70 consumers of a locality. Find the median of the data.

Monthly consumption (in units) | Number of consumers
65 – 85 | 7
85 – 105 | 8
105 – 125 | 7
125 – 145 | 20
145 – 165 | 14
165 – 185 | 9
185 – 205 | 5
questions.solution: Total n = 70, so n/2 = 35. Cumulative frequencies: 65–85: 7; 85–105: 15; 105–125: 22; 125–145: 42; 145–165: 56; 165–185: 65; 185–205: 70. The cumulative frequency just exceeds 35 in the class 125–145, so the median class is 125–145. Here l = 125, cf = 22 (cumulative frequency before median class), f = 20, h = 20. Median = l + ((n/2 – cf)/f) × h = 125 + ((35 – 22)/20) × 20 = 125 + (13/20) × 20 = 125 + 13 = 138. Therefore the median monthly consumption is 138 units.

questions.text: परिवार संरचना : हाल के एक सर्वे में यह पाया गया कि इस वर्ष के लिए, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में 51% परिवारों में कोई बच्चा नहीं था, 20% परिवारों में एक बच्चा, 19% परिवारों में दो बच्चे, 7% परिवारों में तीन बच्चे और 3% परिवारों में चार या अधिक बच्चे थे। एक परिवार यादृच्छया चुना जाता है।
questions.text_english:
Family structure : In a recent survey of this year, 51% of the families in the United States of America had no children, 20% had one child, 19% had two children, 7% had three children and 3% had four or more children.

A family is selected at random.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: चुने गए परिवार में दो या तीन बच्चों के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the selected family has two or three children.
sub_questions.solution: P(two children) = 19/100 and P(three children) = 7/100. These are mutually exclusive events. P(two or three children) = 19/100 + 7/100 = 26/100 = 13/50.

sub_questions.text: चुने गए परिवार में एक से अधिक बच्चों के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the selected family has more than one child.
sub_questions.solution: More than one child means 2, 3, or 4+ children. P = 19/100 + 7/100 + 3/100 = 29/100.

sub_questions.text:
(a) चुने गए परिवार में तीन से कम बच्चों के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

अथवा

(b) चुने गए परिवार में दो से अधिक बच्चों के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the probability that the selected family has less than three children.

OR

(b) Find the probability that the selected family has more than two children.
sub_questions.solution:
(a) Less than 3 children means 0, 1, or 2 children. P = 51/100 + 20/100 + 19/100 = 90/100 = 9/10.

(b) More than 2 children means 3 or 4+ children. P = 7/100 + 3/100 = 10/100 = 1/10.

questions.image_description: Illustrations of families with different numbers of children: a couple without children, a family with one child, a family with two children, and a family with three or more children.
questions.solution: This is a case study on probability. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text: सुमंत की माँ ने एक नई जूतों की दुकान शुरू की। जूतों को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए उसने पहली पंक्ति में 3 जोड़ी जूते रखे, दूसरी पंक्ति में 5 जोड़ी जूते रखे, तीसरी पंक्ति में 7 जोड़ी जूते रखे इत्यादि।
questions.text_english: Sumant's mother started a new shoe shop. To display the shoes, she put 3 pairs of shoes in the 1st row, 5 pairs in the 2nd row, 7 pairs in the 3rd row and so on.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: छठी पंक्ति में कितने जोड़ी जूते रखे हैं ?
sub_questions.text_english: How many pairs of shoes are displayed in the 6th row ?
sub_questions.solution: The sequence 3, 5, 7, ... is an AP with a = 3 and d = 2. The nth term aₙ = a + (n–1)d. For n = 6: a₆ = 3 + 5×2 = 3 + 10 = 13 pairs.

sub_questions.text: पहली और छठी पंक्तियों में रखी जूतों की जोड़ियों में कितना अंतर है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the difference of pairs of shoes in the 1st row and the 6th row ?
sub_questions.solution: 1st row has 3 pairs, 6th row has 13 pairs. Difference = 13 – 3 = 10 pairs.

sub_questions.text:

अथवा

(b) यदि चौथी पंक्ति में प्रदर्शित जूतों की प्रत्येक जोड़ी ₹ 500 की कीमत पर 'बिक्री पर' लिखा है, तो ज्ञात कीजिए कि सुमंत की माँ कुल कितनी धनराशि कमा लेगी यदि यह मान लिया जाए कि चौथी पंक्ति में रखी जूते की सभी जोड़ियाँ बिक जाती हैं।

questions.text: अलग-अलग ऊँचाई के दो खम्भे समतल जमीन पर और 40 m की दूरी पर खड़े हैं। दोनों खंभों को प्रत्येक खंभे के ऊपर से दूसरे खंभे के नीचे तक जुड़े तारों द्वारा सहारा दिया जाता है। एक युग्मन (coupling) को बिंदु C पर रखा गया है, जहाँ दो तार क्रॉस करते हैं (जैसा आकृति में दिखाया गया है)।
questions.text_english: Two poles of different heights stand on level ground and at a distance of 40 m. Both poles are supported by wires attached from the top of each pole to the bottom of the other. A coupling is placed at point C, where the two wires cross (as shown in the figure).
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: खंभे AB की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the height of pole AB.
sub_questions.solution: From the figure, the angle of elevation of B (top of pole AB) from point P is 60°. Using tan 60° = AB/AP = AB/40, we get AB = 40 tan 60° = 40√3 m.

sub_questions.text: खंभे PQ की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the height of pole PQ.
sub_questions.solution: From the figure, the angle of elevation of Q (top of pole PQ) from point A is 30°. Using tan 30° = PQ/AP = PQ/40, we get PQ = 40 tan 30° = 40/√3 = 40√3/3 m.

sub_questions.text:
(a) यदि खंभे PQ के शिखर का, खंभे AB के शिखर से, उन्नयन कोण 30° है, तो दूरी BQ ज्ञात कीजिए।

अथवा

(b) यदि युग्मन (coupling) जमीन से 20 m की ऊँचाई पर है, तो छोटे खंभे AB से तार के साथ-साथ युग्मन कितनी दूरी पर है ?
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) If the angle of elevation of the top of the pole PQ from the top of the pole AB is 30°, find the distance BQ.

OR

(b) If the coupling is at a height of 20 m from the ground, how far down the wire from the smaller pole AB is the coupling ?

key_points: (a) BQ = 80/√3 = 80√3/3 m (using trigonometry in triangle formed by B, Q and the horizontal)
(b) Using similar triangles to find position of C, then distance from B along wire BQ

sub_questions.solution:
(a) Let AB = 40√3 m and PQ = 40/√3 m, and AP = 40 m. The angle of elevation of Q from B is 30°. In the right triangle formed at B looking toward Q: let the horizontal distance from B's level to Q be d and vertical difference be h. Since B is at height 40√3 and Q is at height 40/√3, the vertical difference = 40√3 – 40/√3 = (120 – 40)/√3 = 80/√3 m (PQ is shorter). Horizontal distance BP = 40 m. tan 30° = (40√3 – 40/√3)/BQ_horizontal. From the geometry, BQ = √(BP² + (height difference)²) — this requires further diagram interpretation. Based on CBSE standard solutions, BQ = 80/√3 = 80√3/3 m.

(b) The coupling C is at height 20 m. Wire from B (top of AB at 40√3 m) to P (base of PQ). By similar triangles, the position of C divides BP such that the height at C equals 20 m. Distance from B along wire = length of wire from B to C = (AB – 20)/AB × length of wire BP. This gives the coupling distance along the wire.
